site_name: LAND ON THE EAST SIDE OF, 68 RAVENSBOURNE PARK CRESCENT, LONDON, SE6 4YP
description: An application submitted under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for Minor Material Amendments in connection with the planning permission DC/24/135333 dated 16 October 2024 and Minor Material Application DC/25/140531 dated 07 October 2025 for the Construction of 5 two-storey dwellinghouses, together with cycle parking, refuse storage and associated landscaping for the variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans), to allow :- Plot 1 - Hit and miss brickwork and window on ground floor side return flank wall facing unit 2 removed; Plot 2 - Hit and miss brickwork and window on ground floor side return flank wall facing unit 3 removed; Plot 3 - Hit and miss brickwork and window on ground floor side return flank wall facing unit 4 removed, reflect the approved removal of the hit and miss brickwork detailing to unit 5 and the first-floor flank walls for continuity within the elevations on Land on the East side of 68 Ravensbourne Park Crescent SE6.
